title: SIDESTORY: PEOPLE, A PEOPLE OPEN
lines: DETAILS: People, A People event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [The Hearing] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Botani], Ursus Student Self-government Group Activity Room Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Broken Verses, etc.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Broken Verses by clearing event stages and completing [The Hearing] missions. Broken Verses can be used to redeem items from [Snow-Soaked Campfire].

REWARDS: Botani's Tokens, Ursus Student Self-government Group Activity Room Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, EPOQUE Collection - Infiltrator for Ethan, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Intelligence]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Intelligence].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – RAGE OF THE MANY
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Rage of the Many], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:

NOTE: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game:
- Operator Botani is currently ONLY available from the People, A People event, and is NOT available in [Rage of the Many] headhunting or any [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting].
- Zima the Raging Tide and Ukusik will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after September 30, 2026, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Zima the Raging Tide, Ukusik, and Botani will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 AMBIENCE SYNESTHESIA TAILOR-PROVIDED NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided - Prelude to Transcendence for Surtr
Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided - Blooming Reverie for Nymph

◆After participating in Fashion Review using Orundum, players will randomly get an Outfit from a specified pool, and each player may participate in Fashion Review II and Fashion Review III twice each during the event period. If you already own all outfits in the Fashion Review, buying a Fashion Review item will give a Review Ticket instead (allowing you to redeem an Outfit of your choice in the latest season of Rhodes Fashion Review).

◆Fashion Review II includes 16 outfits, including: Test Collection Series - The Law for Saria and Icefield Messenger Series - York's Bise for SilverAsh; Fashion Review III includes 18 outfits, including: Bloodline of Combat Collection - Refined Horrormare for Lappland and Coral Coast Collection - Waverider WR04 for Skadi.
05 NEW FURNITURE SET – URSUS STUDENT SELF-GOVERNMENT GROUP ACTIVITY ROOM
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Ursus Student Self-government Group Activity Room will be available.
- People, A People event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
Rage of the Many Headhunting Pack
CONTENTS: Rage of the Many Headhunting Permit * 2
Rage of the Many Headhunting Bundle
CONTENTS: Rage of the Many Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1

- Rage of the Many Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a single roll in [Rage of the Many] Limited-time Headhunting; Rage of the Many Ten-roll Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Rage of the Many] Limited-time Headhunting
- Rage of the Many Headhunting Permit and Rage of the Many Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expire at: September 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip * 4, Guard Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
Please stay tuned for more information!
